assumptions: Volume state uses calibrated inventory, measured net delivery and reported pump feedback; commands remain separate.
Level mapping uses the declared piecewise-linear calibration and absolute error bound without extrapolation.
Forecasts hold measured deliveries and pump availability constant unless a candidate explicitly changes an eligible control.
Source potential is inferred as measured net delivery plus the frozen commanded curtailment; its future constancy is an assumption.
Redundant readings must have overlapping absolute bounds; the primary value and bound are retained without averaging.

recommendation.explanation: No validated feasible plan found within search limits. The baseline forecast violates tank_a capacity at ~0.76h (236.5 m3 > 120 m3 capacity). Available controls include: source_a curtail (max 15 m3/h, cost 250/m3), bypass (0-25 m3/h, cost 0), truck_route (0-22 m3/h, cost 80/m3), and backup_pump (16 m3/h, cost 0). Searches of curtail+bypass and curtail+bypass+truck_route combinations hit refinement limits before finding a feasible plan. The core tension: tank_a receives ~52 m3/h from source_a, needs ~116.5 m3 total diversion over 3h to stay under 120 m3 capacity, but control bounds and costs constrain options. Missing: a feasible combination within control bounds that also minimizes cost. Next steps would require extending search bounds or accepting higher cost. No run is staged for approval.
